name: C1406 Czar

origin.basis: CST is the Cheng Shin (正新) brand of Taiwan's Cheng Shin Rubber; China listings give the brand as CST/正新.

manufacturing.basis: The retailer page does not state the factory.

positioning: CST's low-cost wire-bead slick road clincher with an EPS puncture layer.
weight_basis: The retailer gives both 310 g and 240 g for the 25 mm, so no weight is recorded.

community.summary: A short owner video calls it an interesting cheap slick; commenters mention about CNY 20 and marked 25C and 28C wire-bead versions.

availability.note: Listed by a US retailer; owners mention Taobao prices, but no mainland listing was read because the Taobao route stopped at a security check on 2026-11-01.

price_observations.conditions: Regular retailer price on 2026-11-01 for the 25 mm (sale price US$15.99); the page does not tie the price to its single or pair option.

caveats: A heavy-duty entry tire for wear and commuting rather than speed; the retailer weight is inconsistent.
Owners mention a 28 mm wire-bead version, which no maker or shop page confirmed.

image.shown: CST Czar (C1406) render with a casing cutaway, from a US retailer's product page; the bead type is not visible.
image.alt: CST Czar C1406 road tire render with a cutaway showing the casing

rights.copyright_holder: Not stated on the retailer page
rights.usage_note: The retailer's product photo, shown from the retailer's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Checked on 2026-11-03: keyed Xiaohongshu evidence from bounded searches (the first 16-20 result cards of each query, opened exact posts and their visible comments; not exhaustive), coded owner by owner, plus the Sigma Sports and bike-components catalogues and Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test index. Counted only owners who describe their own riding of this model; questions, seller and maker replies, unmounted impressions and reports about other models were left out.

reports.summary: After about 10 km of commuting it felt more sluggish than a Continental GSR.

checks.note: Two posts; a video post has no written report
